The 55-volume hinge is now load-bearing on BOTH sides. recal_64, recal_107 and recal_112 pay below it and this term pays above it; a later round that moves 55 in either term must move it in the other or the two populations overlap.
The paint evidence reads `fouldraw`, `ft` and `orb`, which are also standard-path terms at 0.11 and 0.06. A later round that reweights any of those three changes the floor as well as the path.

78 is inside 80 +-4 but is not the centre. The reachable ceiling on the honest form of this term is ~79 (tilting the evidence toward the glass); reaching 80+ needs the floor to claim the THIRD zone as well, which takes Moses Malone '82 to 87, the outer edge of his 86 +-1 pin. Reported, not applied.
notes: WHY HE READ 69, decomposed: o_score 74.64 x 0.93 = 69.4. The zone block is the whole of it — rim 60 at 0.22 = 13.20 and mid 50 at 0.08 = 4.00, against his own '82 card's 20.90 + 5.36 on the same usage (26.9 against 28.7) and the same true shooting (.570 against .578). recal_37's dominance bonus cannot fire for him either: its shape gate needs z[0] > z[1] + z[2] AND z[0] >= 91, and his best zone is 60.

The bar is not this agent's to move. rim and mid are MEASURED from the shot tables only from 1997; before that build_ratings.py infers them from a model fitted on 1997-2005 and regressed toward each season's mean — the compression RATINGS_UPDATE.md ratifies. Nothing in this round touches an attribute; the attribute sheet is byte-identical on all 10,000 cards.

The defect the round fixes is general, not an era patch: recal_46 already wrote it down one term up the file — 'A paint weapon's damage is mostly OFF the shot — fouls drawn, offensive boards, the defence he collapses — and the standard path prices almost none of it' — but paid it only through recal_37's SHAPE gate on the zone vector, which is exactly the number that is wrong about this card. 66 of the 103 movers are MEASURED-era cards.

REJECTED, measured on the whole pool. (1) A re-weighted POST-SCORER floor (0.34 volume + 0.26 efficiency + 0.26 free throws + 0.18 orb + 0.12 ballsec, r91's 1.16 total) reaches Moses '85 at 77 but takes Moses '82 from 85 to 90 and breaks his recal_52 pin, because '82 leads '85 on every input the floor reads. (2) Flooring z[0] ALONE at the evidence tops out at +8.0 of o_score even at z0 = 99 and cannot honestly claim a 99 rim bar. (3) Lifting the global efficiency weight is the same wall recal_91, recal_98 and recal_112 all hit and is recorded there.

The class was read before the term was chosen: Moses '82/'83/'85, Kareem '80/'85, Hakeem '90, Ewing '90, Robinson '92, Shaq '00, Karl Malone '97, Barkley '90. Every one of them except the subject and Moses '83 (77 -> 79) is unmoved, and each is unmoved for the same reason — his zone block already stands above what his free throws and his offensive glass can claim.
